title: bug: a notification-only session can't reply when its idle seat's worker record was pruned (chat_send "Unknown sender"), and the mention stays unread
description:
Observed 2026-10-25T13:09Z: the wrapper launched a notification-only session for worker-07cd2c56 to answer routed mention msg-185b0639451c4fce9e18c139d4298fb2 (chan-b6d8273b). The daemon had no record for that worker (it was absent from list_workers), so the required reply failed. chat_send and chat_join both answer 'Unknown sender: workerId must be a registered worker or "human"' (packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/chatSend.ts:51, chatJoin.ts:31).
Nothing re-registers an idle seat whose record was pruned. retry_team_join returns early once TEAM_JOINED=true (scripts/moe-agent.sh:2064; its ps1 twin is Invoke-MoeTeamJoinRetry). claim_next_task creates the worker only on a successful claim (tools/claimNextTask.ts:648-651), and the notification-only prompt forbids claiming.
Side effect: chat_read silently skips the cursor write for an unknown worker (state/workerStore.ts:214), so the mention is never marked read. It will likely resurface in another notification-only launch on each later no-task iteration (inferred from the code; repeats not yet observed).
definitionOfDone: A notification-only session launched for a seat whose worker record was pruned can send its chat_send reply under that seat's own workerId, never as "human".
Reading the surfaced mention advances that seat's chat cursor, so the same mention does not trigger another notification-only launch.
A regression test (a postflight.{sh,ps1} scenario and/or a daemon test) covers a pruned idle seat with an unread routed mention.

implementationPlan.description: Update both wrappers: add explicit force-refresh mode to retry_team_join/Invoke-MoeTeamJoinRetry while preserving default cached retry behavior. Invoke force refresh once at each fresh preflight BEFORE any chat_join/chat_read or routed-mention consumption, including notification-only and idle iterations; never require a successful task claim. Allow governors on this force path and preserve role:'governor' when creating their team. Validate accepted RPC response rather than treating arbitrary nonempty data as success; on force failure clear stale joined state, keep pending mentions unread, suppress notification launch and reuse existing poll/loop handling (a no-loop invocation exits with a clear failure rather than spinning). Error handling must preserve task/baseline state and never fall back to sender human; retry next iteration and deduplicate unchanged failure/success logs. Do not relax notification prompts' no-claim/no-work rule or add .moe writes.
implementationPlan.note: retry_team_join [force] / Invoke-MoeTeamJoinRetry -Force: force re-joins even a cached-joined seat, governors included (create_team keeps role:'governor'); clears stale TEAM_JOINED first; success only when the join_team answer's team.id == TEAM_ID and memberIds lists this worker (JSON-RPC error, MCP isError, {success:true}, foreign list, no answer all refused); healthy forced re-join logs nothing, recovery logs 'no longer teamless' once, failure logs MOE_SEAT_UNREGISTERED (with "this seat's chat stays unread until a pre-flight join succeeds") only when the error changes; 'Team not found: ' drops the cached TEAM_ID so the next retry re-creates the team by name (else a team deleted from the IDE would leave the seat chat-less forever). Called once at the top of each AUTO_CLAIM pre-flight BEFORE chat_channels/chat_join/chat_read; SEAT_REGISTERED/$seatRegistered gates those plus the routed chat_wait backlog, so a failed join reads nothing, keeps mentions unread and (count 0) suppresses the notification launch. Claim path unchanged except the now-redundant pre-claim cached retry removed (the forced call ran moments earlier); wait-loop cached retry kept. No-loop/one-shot run that ends teamless with no launch prints MOE_SEAT_UNREGISTERED ... exit 1 and exits 1. No prompt/.moe writes, no claim needed. Scope growth: postflight-fake-proxy.js and mention-provenance-proxy.js now answer join_team like the daemon ({team:{id,memberIds:[workerId]}}) because strict validation refuses their old {success:true}. Evidence: seat-registration WSL bash 18/18; native Windows node 54-case run (Git Bash/PS5.1/PS7) green before the deleted-team case was added, deleted-team case green on bash; parity-check.sh PASS; mention-provenance.sh PASS; postflight.sh PASS (rerun: first run's scenario AD hit a torn read because I edited moe-agent.sh mid-run); postflight.ps1 on Windows PS 5.1 PASS (73 frozen + scope + team join/heal). Other sessions' dirty paths (e.g. docs/MCP_SERVER.md isEpicFinal edits) untouched.

implementationPlan.note: Adversarial review (skill loaded) of this task's paths only. Fixes made during the review, all before the final green gate, so no gate rerun is needed: (1) PS local `$team` shadowed the script's `$Team` (case-insensitive), garbling the success/warn messages; renamed to $joinedTeam, with team-name assertions added. (2) A team deleted from the IDE left a stale TEAM_ID cached, so every forced join failed forever and the seat stopped reading chat (a regression); 'Team not found: ' now drops the id and the next retry re-creates the team. (3) The bash validator used `in` on a possibly non-list memberIds; it now requires a list. Checked and OK: pruned after a successful loop (cached joined → force re-join recreates the record); DEAD after hot reload (the join revives it, deregister had already nulled currentTaskId, so no stale task comes back); busy live rejoin (addTeamMember returns early for an existing member even when the team is full, clearMembershipTombstone is a no-op, status/task/cursors kept); repeated registration writes nothing and logs only on change; full/missing team, JSON-RPC error, isError, malformed, foreign, unlisted and silent answers are all refused and read no chat; governor create keeps role:'governor'; one-shot exits 1. The identity is restored before any chat call in both launchers: they have no chat_read/chat_wait before the forced call, and the task-channel read runs only after a claim binds a task. Unknown/system chat senders are still refused; touchWorker never revives DEAD (daemon tests). No task claims or prompt changes; only TEAM_* vars change, so baseline and attempt state are untouched. A second read excludes the original mention (bash/PS tests + daemon test). Theoretical, left as is: chat_join posts its presence message only on a process's first iteration, so a seat whose first pre-flight join failed never posts it (cosmetic); a governor still launches when its forced join fails (not a notification launch).

comments.author: governor-96f92f36
comments.content:
Governor finding, 2026-10-26: the same root cause also hits a seat whose record goes DEAD, not just one whose record was pruned. Please plan for both.

Observed: at 04:45:16Z a wrapper hot reload (any edit to scripts/moe-agent.sh) ran the reload path, which calls deregister_worker {reason:"wrapper_restart"} and then exec. Idle worker-3729a0d6 came back as the same process (pid 130561, MOE_WORKER_ID intact) and has been looping "Agent idle, checking for tasks in 30 seconds" ever since. It calls moe RPCs every cycle, yet list_workers has shown it DEAD with lastActivityAt frozen at 04:44:45Z for 15+ minutes. worker-7d158765 was in the same limbo from 03:07Z (pruned) until its own reload re-joined the team at 04:45:41Z.

Why (daemon source):
- joinTeam.ts only creates a record when getWorker() is empty; an existing DEAD record stays DEAD.
- claimNextTask.ts only creates or updates the record (status READING_CONTEXT) on a successful claim. hasNext:false leaves it untouched.
- touchWorker deliberately refuses DEAD records, so heartbeats and other calls never revive it.
So the wrapper comment "the re-exec'd wrapper registers afresh" holds only for a seat that claims a task right away.

Impact: the seat still picks up work, because a claim revives it. But it shows DEAD/hidden in list_workers and the IDE, and mentionRouter skips DEAD workers. Once the record is pruned, chat_send fails with "Unknown sender", which is this task's symptom.

A fix covering both: have a fresh-session registration (join_team at wrapper pre-flight) revive a DEAD record to IDLE. Keep touchWorker's refusal for in-flight calls from the old session. Alternatively, skip the deregister on a reload when the seat holds no task.

comments.author: architect-1520cc31
comments.content: Plan includes the governor's DEAD-record finding, not just pruned records. Minimal fix stays at registration boundary: fresh preflight force-rejoins before chat_join/chat_read (current retry sits after general chat read and returns early when cached joined), and successful join_team revives DEAD to IDLE without relaxing chat sender checks or touchWorker's DEAD refusal. Covers all default role teams, including governors; no task claim is needed. Five files total with dedicated daemon and executable wrapper-block regression tests. To serialize shared files, the already-planned live-assignee wrapper guard and the new daemon worker-type prerequisite now depend on this task; this task has no new dependencies and can run first.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Repair explicit registration, not chat authentication. Auto-registering arbitrary chat senders or weakening touchWorker's DEAD refusal would revive old sessions/impersonation paths. No new MCP tool needed: join_team already creates missing workers. Refresh the wrapper's cached membership at fresh preflight before reading inbox, and revive DEAD only through a successful explicit team join. This is five files, no split required. Claiming tasks solely to recreate identity is forbidden and unnecessary.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Verified ordering bug: sh general chat read at ~6321 precedes cached retry_team_join at ~6346; PS twin same. retry_team_join/Invoke-MoeTeamJoinRetry return immediately when TEAM_JOINED/teamJoined is true and exclude governors. Add force-refresh mode called before first chat_join/read on every preflight; keep normal cached retries cheap. Startup teams default Workers/Architects/QA/Governors; governor team create must retain role:'governor'. joinTeamTool only creates absent records and addTeamMember returns early for existing members, so DEAD needs explicit status IDLE update after successful membership. chatReadTool already writes cursor through updateWorkerCursors when record exists; chatSendTool rejects genuinely unknown worker and reserved system. Tests can use ToolTestHarness, StateManager.deleteWorker, joinTeamTool/chatReadTool/chatSendTool and real extracted launcher blocks.
planningNotes.risks: Governor comment requires both pruned and DEAD seats; include both. Never reset a healthy busy seat's status/currentTaskId or clear cursors during rejoin. Team full/not-found/malformed RPC cannot be counted as success, and failed registration must not consume mentions or launch a doomed notification CLI. Preserve existing cached behavior for ordinary retry sites and log only changes, not one successful-rejoin banner every idle poll. Wrapper changes must stay Bash3.2/PowerShell5.1+7 compatible; tests may not call live daemon or modify shared config. No source implementation edits by this architect. The two pending tasks that overlap joinTeam/wrappers are structurally ordered after this one (0b40957c and 6aa460bb).

completionSummary:
Pruned or DEAD idle seats re-register before reading chat, so a notification-only session replies under its own workerId and the mention's cursor advances.
Daemon (checkpoint 81dff6d): join_team revives a DEAD record to IDLE after a successful join (type, currentTaskId and cursors kept). touchWorker and the chat tools are unchanged. Test: joinTeam.notification.test.ts (7).
Wrappers (sh and ps1 twins):
- `retry_team_join force` / `Invoke-MoeTeamJoinRetry -Force` runs at the top of every pre-flight, before chat_channels/chat_join/chat_read, governors included (their create keeps role:'governor').
- A join counts only when the answer's team.id matches and its memberIds list contains the seat. Error, isError, malformed, foreign, string and silent answers are refused.
- While the join fails, no chat is read and the routed chat_wait backlog is skipped, so mentions stay unread and no notification CLI launches. The next pre-flight retries.
- Logging is deduplicated: MOE_SEAT_UNREGISTERED prints only when the error changes, and recovery prints once.
- 'Team not found' drops a stale team id so the team is re-created.
- A one-shot run that ends teamless exits 1. The redundant pre-claim cached retry is removed.
Test fakes: postflight-fake-proxy.js and mention-provenance-proxy.js now answer join_team the way the daemon does.
New test scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs runs the launchers' real pre-flight segments against a fake proxy:
- pruned worker/qa/architect and DEAD worker: the seat replies as itself and is not notified again;
- governor team creation; 6 refusal shapes; log dedupe; deleted team; create failure; one-shot exit 1/0; cached retry makes no call.
RED on the old launchers: 16 of 17 bash cases failed.
Also green: postflight.sh (WSL), postflight.ps1 (PS 5.1, includes team join/heal), mention-provenance.sh, and parity on WSL bash.
Note: parity under Git Bash needs LC_ALL=C; HEAD fails the same way without it.
